notes: Reached by DIRECT fetch (no bot protection); Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Sites-TCS-Site. Counts are the rendered listing header ('N Results' / 'Showing 24 of N Products'). Verified by enumerating every grid tile through the site's own Search-UpdateGrid controller (cgid + start/sz=200): tile counts matched the header exactly on Mirrors 30, Lamps 55, Outdoor Lighting 19, Tabletop 142, Decorative Accents 134, Window Curtains 19, Kids Lamps 16, Kids Wall Art 21. Independent cross-check: the Curtain Hardware facet reports 11 and exactly 11 of the 19 enumerated Window Curtains tiles are rods/finials/drapery rings/wand. This is overwhelmingly a bedding and textile retailer, so the in-scope list is deliberately short. EXCLUDED: all bedding, sheets, comforters, pillows, duvets, quilts, shams, blankets and throws, decorative pillow covers, bath linens and towels, loungewear, mattresses; all rugs and doormats; tablecloths, table runners, placemats, napkins and tea towels; furniture and accent tables; Wallpaper (139 - a wall-covering/finishing material, and no earlier worker in this project emitted a wallpaper row); Wreaths & Botanicals / Garlands / Potted Plants / Topiaries (faux botanicals, out of scope this batch); Holiday; and all Sale/Clearance/New/Best Seller/collaboration (Rifle Paper Co., Stoffer Home, Heather Taylor Home, Villa d'Ascoli) landing pages. DROPPED AS A RE-CUT: Outdoor Tabletop (/outdoor-dinnerware, 73) - 143 of its 144 product IDs are already inside Tabletop. DROPPED AS A MIXED ROLL-UP: Decorative Accents (/home-accents, 134) - it bundles ~22 wreaths/garlands/botanicals, 3 accent tables (furniture) and re-cuts of Lamps (55 shared IDs) and Mirrors (35 shared IDs); it is replaced by its own product-type navigation children, which is where the 7 leaf rows below come from. Also dropped: All Home Accents (/nav-decor-hd-type, 757) and All Kitchen & Table Linens (/kitchen-tabletop, 300), both mostly textiles. Site sells no clocks as a category (site search returns 4 products) and has no adult wall-art category (kids only). Known minor cross-listing: Tabletop (142) and the Decorative Accents children share roughly 19-28 products (the vases and candlestick holders appear under both nav categories); neither is a subset of the other so both are kept.
